critical_code_review_comments: rob-portfolio.vue is a monolithic single-component file (>2600 lines including template + script + styles). Consider splitting into Header, PortfolioGrid, Lightbox, AdminAddCardModal, AboutMe components for maintainability.

Uses window.alert() to surface Firebase login errors including raw JSON payload (see dialog message during test). Should show a friendly localized error via existing toast/sweetalert library instead of alert().

App talks directly to production Firestore from the client with no backend abstraction — any leaked admin session can mutate production. Consider Firestore security rules review and moving admin writes behind a small backend.
